# Vacuum

Scheduled database compaction: online VACUUM for a single app; under pocker, one stopped instance at a time.

**Runs on:** Single app, or many under [pocker](/docs/plugins/pocker).

> **Planned.** Nothing is published here yet. This folder will hold the plugin's Go module
> (`github.com/pockethost/pocketone/ext/vacuum`), its tests and a minimal `example/main.go` that builds and shows the
> feature. See [Create your own plugin](/docs/writing-a-plugin).
